slides.headline: 6 FREE AI PROMPTS THAT WILL WRITE YOUR ENTIRE BUSINESS PLAN TONIGHT
1) WRITE THE EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
slides.body: Business plan consultants charge $2,400 to write just the executive summary. "Write a 1-page executive summary: problem, solution, market size, business model, and why I win. Plain language a banker can act on."

slides.headline: 2) BUILD YOUR MARKET ANALYSIS
slides.body: Market research reports cost $5,000 from a consulting firm. "Name my exact target customer, market size, 3 biggest trends, and 3 biggest risks. Flag where I need to verify numbers."

slides.headline: 3) MAP YOUR COMPETITION
slides.body:
One gap your competitors share is worth more than the rest of this document.

"Name 5 real competitors: what they charge, who they serve, and the gap I can own."

slides.headline: 4) BUILD YOUR FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS
slides.body: The financials section is the first thing a bank opens. Most business plans fail here. "Build a 3-year revenue table and list the 5 biggest costs you'll face."

slides.headline: 5) WRITE YOUR MARKETING STRATEGY
slides.body: Marketing consultants charge $150 an hour for strategy sessions. "Write a 90-day marketing plan: the 2 channels I focus on first, what to run each week, and how I measure results."

slides.headline: 6) BUILD THE OPERATIONS PLAN
slides.body:
Most first-time writers skip the operations section. Investors and banks notice every time.

"Walk me through: who does what, how an order reaches delivery, and what breaks first at scale."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You'll want these 6 prompts the next time you sit down to plan. Save this post and run them in order.

Daily AI news and real skills from the people using it
